transcription: How my best friend or brother went completely insane, this is a story that has happened within the past week or so, that is so shocking that it changed my whole outlook on life. I have a friend, we'll call him Cammy for confidentiality reasons. He is an 18-year-old friend of mine that clicked with me on the first day of high school. He was a genuine, kind, God-spoken man, or so I thought. Well, him and his sister had it home, causing them to leave their home because they couldn't bear to live with their dad anymore. That's a story for another time as soon as I got the news that they were homeless, I was quick to tell my mom. My mother let them stay with us, and everything was going well, up until a couple weeks ago. Cammy started acting. Different. He would ramble on and on about the Bible, which was normal for him, but these conversations he would have were never like the ones before. He would talk about women non-stop, and how they should always obey any man, just because they were men, and he would always say, that is what God said. I wouldn't think anything of it. Until, I got a message from a friend that I haven't talked to in weeks. We'll call her Emily. Emily is a 15-year-old that I have been friends with since 5th grade. She sent me screenshots between her and Cammy, where he asked her, where in your backyard can you hide? Which shocked me because I wouldn't have ever thought he would ask anyone that, let alone a 15-year-old girl. The conversation continued. He talked to her about how he wanted to show her the real future, and he warned her that he was going to touchy, but sneaky touchy because, God said to hide anything not pure to him. She reacted with a thumbs-down emoji. I sent all of the screenshots to my mom. She told me that she would handle it and I thought nothing of it after a while. Then I was notified by a Facebook post on a local page about things that happened in my small town. It had multiple photos and videos of him in the middle of the night, roaming around my neighborhood faking injuries, trying to break into people's homes, and trying to smash car windows. Something I've never thought he would do. The police were called in the EMS stated that he admitted to being on drugs. He got arrested, then discharged soon after. I was confused. Why would he do all of this? Just then, I got another text from his sister, he's banging on my door, me and your sisters are home alone with him. I'm scared. I told her to call my mom and tell her that he's scaring the girls. He walked out the house again, and straight over to a retired police officer's house, and then he started acting erratic again. Around 517, the police arrived and he was arrested for the final time. He was charged with public intoxication and breach of peace. What about the messages? I asked my mom. She responded with, the police didn't even look into the messages. I was pissed. How can someone just glance over messages between a 15-year-old and an 18-year-old? Why would someone just brush past that? I was confused, upset, and hurt all at the same time. All I could do was sit there and shock knowing my own brother, the person I thought I could look up to, became a monster in an instant. As he was placed into the police car, he yelled, I am the devil, the door closed. That was the day my whole life changed. The person that helped me open my eyes to God was the person that closed his. I'm still in pure shock for what has happened these past couple days, and if you have any questions feel free to comment.
